pattern: てもどうにもならない
purpose: Dismiss an action as unable to improve the situation.
keywords: Vて + もどうにもならない
Regretting it now will not change anything.
Waiting here will do no good.
My making a fuss alone will not change anything.
formation: Vて + もどうにもならない
restrictions: The action cannot change the relevant result.
mistake: This is practical futility, not necessarily inability to perform the action.

segments.text: でもどうにもならない
